name: anlide/hilos-demo-websocket-test
description: WebSocket test demo project for Hilos v2 framework

scripts.install-deps: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli composer install
scripts.setup-env: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli php -r "require 'vendor/autoload.php'; \\Hilos\\Utils\\Env::init(); echo '.env file initialized.';"
scripts.daemon-status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli php src/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm websocket-test-monitor php src/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli php src/Bootstrap/cli.php
